issues.title: Store room passphrase securely instead of plaintext QSettings
issues.description: The room passphrase is now persisted across restarts via QSettings, which writes it in plaintext (Linux ~/.config, macOS plist). For a privacy-focused app this is a meaningful exposure: anyone with read access to that file can decrypt the room's traffic. Replace plaintext storage with the OS keychain (libsecret/Keychain, e.g. Qt Keychain) and/or gate persistence behind an opt-in "Remember passphrase" checkbox (default off).
